notes.title: Patchnotes 0.0.15
notes.content:
Update 0.0.15

-New maps.

-Changed ridiculous marble currency into dollars.

-Save or Enslave Mechanic.

-More story branching.

-Added Missions (Accessible through the Menu)

-Difficulties!

-Fixed a zombie "killswitch" that made all the zombies in
the game dissapear.
